evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To bridge this gap, we introduce MinCU, a benchmark for grounded minimal-change understanding, where each sample consists of an image pair differing by a single atomic variation in object category, attribute, count, or spatial position, and models are evaluated on their ability to describe the change, localize the changed regions, and identify the changed entity.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Compared to the previous chain-of-thought method, fine-tuning with SG-ISA yields substantial joint improvements in grounding accuracy and description quality while reducing reasoning-token overhead by approximately 26%.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Existing benchmarks largely assess semantic comparison or single-image grounding in isolation, without jointly requiring faithful description and physical localization.
